# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Windows Sandbox

Restricts Windows Sandbox, which otherwise opens a disposable Windows with access to the network and the host's clipboard.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Device Security - U - Windows Sandbox |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Sandbox.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Sandbox.json) |

> Device-scoped settings, hence D — see the remark on Device Guard.
